A single bold stroke of Prussian blue ink sweeps across the paper behind him, swelling and curling into a giant wave with claw-like white foam. The camera dollies forward as the ink wave rushes past in layered parallax and fills the whole screen, revealing the woodblock print 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' with three boats and a small Mount Fuji in the distance.
